name: Shamiana
summary: Wedding hall and marquee desk: event calendar, per-head menus, advances and a kitchen prep list
about: A booking desk for a Pakistani banquet hall or marquee. A month calendar shows Mehndi, Barat and Walima events per hall, new bookings price the menu per head with a live capacity check, advances and balances are tracked in PKR, and the kitchen gets a prep list for the day. Built for hall managers and banquet owners.
how: Open New booking, pick the date, slot, hall, guests and menu. The price adds up as you type and the seating plan fills table by table; going over capacity turns it red.
Save it as confirmed or tentative with an advance (the minimum advance rule is checked).
Open the Calendar, filter by hall, click a day for its lunch and dinner plan, and drag an event to another day to reschedule it.
Click any booking to add payments, confirm or cancel it, print an invoice, or tap Balance reminder to open a ready WhatsApp text (wa.me link).
Open Kitchen to get the combined prep list for a day (rice, meat, naan, raita, sweets, drinks) and tick items off as they are ready.
Edit halls, capacities, rents and menu packages, and change the reminder text or reset the demo in Settings.
